title: Turpedo
description:
• 1 to 4 Players in either Local or Online Multiplayer.

• Dodge, Deflect & Dive in aquatic arcade action.

• Evolve as you play with each round a new chance to adapt.

• Ascend the depths, escape collapsing wrecks or plunder treasure in different game modes.

• Defeat 5 difficulties of bots to become the master of the depths and unlock new mutations.
Infested DepthsYou're never alone in the water! Grabbing tentacles, nipping barracuda's, gentle jellyfish & more keep you on your toes whilst debris and mines fall around you. Falling wrecks may offer some recluse and powerups.Evolve To VictoryStart by picking your torpedo and gather enough nucleons during each round to later mutate and overcome your foes with lethal abilities. Only the last round counts for the victory, so you're always in the game till the end.

Game ModesWant to mix it up? Team up in Hoard mode, fight your way out of a collapsing debris in Wreck or fight through the depths in Ascension. Each game mode offers unique rules and levels to keep it fresh.
description_short: Deep-sea chaotic duels where players incarnate submarines for victory over polluted oceans. Evolve as you play with a range of mutations in round based combat over multiple game modes.
